description: Write a pandas DataFrame as Avro to a local path or fsspec URI. Schema is inferred from pandas dtypes by default; explicit schema can be supplied via avro_schema. Companion to dataframe_to_parquet — useful when downstream consumers expect Avro (Event Hubs Capture default, Kafka Schema Registry ecosystems, etc.).

upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key (must materialize a pandas DataFrame)
upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key

file_path.label: File Path
file_path.description: Destination path or fsspec URI. Supports {partition_key} and ${ENV_VAR} substitution.

record_name.label: Record Name
record_name.description: Name in the inferred Avro schema (ignored if avro_schema is set)

avro_schema.label: Avro Schema
avro_schema.description: Optional explicit Avro schema dict (overrides inference)

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

partition_type.description: daily \| weekly \| monthly \| hourly \| static \| dynamic \| None
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'customer_a,customer_b,customer_c'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in ONE run: if File Path is templated on the partition key (e.g. {partition_key}) one file is written per key in the range -- this needs a per-partition upstream (partition-aware IO manager handing the asset a dict of DataFrames keyed by partition key; this component has no row-level partition filter) and raises a clear error otherwise; a non-templated File Path gets the whole range in a single file. 'multi_run' launches one run per partition (optionally capped via Backfill Max Partitions Per Run). Leave empty for Dagster's default (one run per partition, uncapped). Ignored when Partition Type is not set. Requires a partition-range-aware IO manager for the upstream asset (e.g. a DB-table IO manager with partition_expr set, or InMemoryIOManager in tests) -- a generic filesystem IO manager cannot persist/load a single_run output spanning multiple partitions and raises a clear error at materialization time.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only.

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows -- e.g. a daily set never includes today until tomorrow. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset, matching Dagster's own default).

name: Dataframe to Avro
